svg.text: Versus test: Hob next to Flattener, solid fill, then 24 px
Hobs: domes, cones, floppy brims, puffs. Round tops.
Flatteners: one flat line on top, one straight tool.
Team cue: blue scarf (you) vs orange tie (rival),
backed by side of screen, flag shape and pips.
Bonked Flatteners float off on a square balloon.
